caption: The drawing features a decorative ceramic plate illustrated from two perspectives: a top view and a side view. The plate is predominantly white or light gray, with a scalloped and ornate rim that includes molded scrollwork and embossed patterns. Around the rim, there are clusters of small, delicate floral designs in shades of purple and violet, with some brownish-red accents for leaves and stems. The plate has a shallow depth, as indicated by the side view, and the overall surface of the plate appears smooth and glossy, with light shading to depict gloss and depth. The artist’s signature, “Geoffrey Holt,” is present at the lower right corner of the drawing. The background is off-white with some faint brownish stains and shadows, and the drawing is rendered in a realistic style with watercolor or colored pencil techniques.
title: China Plate
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
